data.name: Tie-Dye Fun
data.headline: Sun, Tue, Thur | 3pm
data.description: Join us for a vibrant tie-dye event where creativity meets color! Participants will have the chance to design their own unique pieces using a variety of dyes and techniques. Purchase a white shirt through or bring your own favorite white shirt, and let your imagination run wild as you create stunning, one-of-a-kind designs!
data.what_is_included:
Tie Dye equipment
White T-Shirt or you may bring your own T-Shirt. 

$31.80 per Shirt

$16 Bring Your Own Shirt!
data.cancellation_summary: Please email the Recreation Department at recreation@paradisepoint.com to inform us of your cancellation.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund or credit. If we need to cancel your reservation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, you will also receive a full refund or credit.

**To cancel or inquire about your reservation, please contact us by phone 619-247-9345**. No-shows and cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation will be charged in full.
data.booking_notes:
You're all set. Head over to Tidal Beach on the designated day and time to start your tie dye experience. Please note, limited sizes available. 

Please cancel 24 hours in advance.
